citations.assessment: The Bavli names Yonatan ben Akhinai, Yonatan ben Elazar and Chanina bar Chama together. Retain Heilprin’s shorter spelling as his reading.

The compared Rif names Yochanan bar Armai, Yochanan bar Elazar, and Chanina bar Abba. The immediate list supports expanding Chanina’s initials as ben Abba in this report. Preserve Akhmai as Heilprin’s reported Rif reading and record Armai as the checked variant.
The end of chapter 11 contains Abbahu’s teaching from Yonatan ben Akhmai and his praise of Yonatan. In this witness the subsequent exposition is before Rav.

citations.assessment: The blessing narrative names ben Asmai in this Bavli witness and Yehudah ben Gerim. The checked passage does not equate ben Asmai with ben Akhmai.
The reciprocal entry cites Moed Katan 9a for the blessing and preserves additional competing names.
The narrative explicitly alternates the order of the two names and does not identify which was absent for ordination.
The reciprocal entry gives the Sanhedrin account and preserves the two names.

The primary passage actually calls the family Beit Tzevuim descended from ben Akhmai, alongside Beit Kufai descended from ben Mekoshesh. Keep Heilprin’s compressed wording and surface the precise distinction.
